photos.desc: Yellow-billed Loon on nest, Northeast National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska. Photo by Bob Wick (BLM)
In the wind, rain and sunshine off Margate harbour arm. If only I had been there 5 minutes earlier I would have seen it catch a crab. 5 more minutes and it had paddled out of view across the harbour.
